sections.preamble: You are a coding assistant running inside pi, a coding agent harness. Help users inspect files, run commands, and modify code.
sections.tools:
<tools>
- read: Read file contents
- bash: Execute bash commands (ls, grep, find, etc.)
- edit: Make precise file edits with exact text replacement, including multiple disjoint edits in one call
- write: Create or overwrite files

Additional tools may be available.
</tools>
sections.rules:
<rules>
- Use bash for file operations like ls, rg, find
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- You can inspect PI_* environment variables for current model and session details.
- Use edit for targeted changes. Batch changes to one file in a single call.
- Each edits[].oldText must exactly and uniquely match the original file. Keep matches short and non-overlapping; merge nearby changes without including large unchanged regions.
- Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: bash
toolsAdded.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

toolsAdded.name: write
toolsAdded.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

content.text:
# Тестовое задание: сделать копию веб-приложения

Сделай копию теста DISC, размещённого на странице школы менеджмента
Stratoplan.

**Источник**: https://stratoplan-school.com/disc/

Изучи страницу и её код самостоятельно, собери всё необходимое и перенеси
функционал.

## Что нужно сделать

Одностраничное HTML-приложение — копия теста с этой страницы, работающее так
же, как оригинал: пользователь проходит тест шагами, ранжирует варианты
перетаскиванием, в конце видит свои баллы.

## Требования к копии

1. Один самодостаточный файл `index.html`: все стили и скрипты инлайн.
2. **Без бэкенда и без отправки данных куда-либо.** Шаг сбора email и
   переход на отдельную страницу результата из оригинала убрать: после
   завершения теста баллы показываются в том же приложении.
3. **Без внешних запросов**: без CDN и внешних библиотек, приложение
   работает офлайн, открывается локально (`file://`).
4. Данные теста и поведение интерфейса — как в оригинале; язык интерфейса —
   русский; визуальное оформление — на твоё усмотрение.
5. Иконки — инлайн SVG, растровые изображения не нужны.
6. Целевые браузеры — актуальные Chrome, Firefox, Safari.

## Формат результата

Рабочий `index.html` в текущей директории. Пояснения не нужны.

summary:
## Goal
Create a self-contained `index.html` copy of the DISC test from https://stratoplan-school.com/disc/. The test uses a step-by-step interface where users rank options by drag-and-drop and see scores at the end. Requirements: single HTML file with inline CSS/JS, no backend, no email collection or external result page, no CDN/external libraries (must work offline via file://), Russian UI, inline SVG icons only, no raster images. Target browsers: Chrome, Firefox, Safari.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Single HTML file with inline CSS and JS
- No backend dependencies
- No email collection or external result page
- No CDN or external libraries (must work offline via file://)
- Russian UI
- Inline SVG icons only, no raster images
- Target browsers: Chrome, Firefox, Safari
- Remove all analytics (Plausible), external fonts (Font Awesome), and external asset references

## Progress
### Done
- [x] Downloaded the original page (538,959 bytes) to `/tmp/disc_original.html`
- [x] Converted encoding from cp1251 to UTF-8 for readability → `/tmp/disc_original_utf8.html`
- [x] Examined page structure: identified hero section, header, and modal triggers
- [x] Identified that the test functionality is in external JS files (not inline), specifically `disc_patched.js` (core DISC logic), `app.js` (page-level scripts), `tracker.js`, and `fab.js`
- [x] Identified all external script references: Plausible analytics, GSAP/ScrollTrigger CDN, `js/app.js`, `js/disc_patched.js`, `js/tracker.js`, `/assets/js/fab.js`
- [x] Confirmed modal ID is `wizardmodal` (triggered by `data-modal-open="wizardmodal"` at lines 156/489/551); secondary modal `#apruve` exists for approval
- [x] Successfully downloaded all JS files after unstable server responses:
  - `/tmp/extracted/app.js` (18996 bytes) — page scripts (speakers slider, etc.)
  - `/tmp/extracted/disc_patched.js` (21650 bytes) — **core DISC test logic**
  - `/tmp/extracted/tracker.js` (2036 bytes) — event tracking
  - `/tmp/extracted/fab.js` (5058 bytes) — floating action button
- [x] Examined `disc_patched.js` structure: IIFE with helpers (`qs`, `qsa`, `base64urlEncode`, `strToBytes`, `concatBytes`), scroll lock management (`syncScrollLock`), modal open/close, DOM anchors for wizard steps, tabs, panes, prev/next/finish buttons, and progress bar
- [x] Confirmed the test is fully client-side (no backend calls for scoring); the "apruve" modal handles form confirmation

### In Progress
- [ ] Locate and extract the wizard modal HTML (question data, ranking options, step panes) from the original HTML
- [ ] Extract the full `disc_patched.js` logic (scoring algorithm, question data, drag-and-drop implementation)
- [ ] Review `app.js` for any additional test-related logic
- [ ] Strip: Plausible analytics scripts, Font Awesome CDN, GSAP/ScrollTrigger CDN, email form, external links
- [ ] Replace external assets with inline SVGs and data URIs
- [ ] Build the final single-file `index.html` with all CSS and JS inlined

### Blocked
- [ ] Server instability when downloading JS files (resolved by retry logic with DOCTYPE check)

## Key Decisions
- **Use external JS files as source for logic**: The DISC test logic was not inline in HTML but in `disc_patched.js`. The full file (21650 bytes) must be extracted and inlined into the final output.
- **Remove all CDN dependencies**: GSAP/ScrollTrigger (3.12.2), Font Awesome, Plausible analytics must all be replaced with vanilla JS or removed entirely.
- **Preserve drag-and-drop ranking**: The test uses HTML5 drag-and-drop (confirmed via SEO keywords) for ranking options; this must be implemented with native browser APIs.
- **Remove email collection**: The "apruve" modal appears to handle form submission/email collection — this must be removed or replaced with a simple client-side result display.
- **Scoring is client-side**: The base64url encoding and byte manipulation helpers in `disc_patched.js` suggest scoring/report generation happens in-browser.

## Next Steps
1. Read the full `disc_patched.js` (currently truncated at ~57%) to extract question data, scoring formula, and drag-and-drop logic
2. Search the HTML for the wizard modal content (question steps, ranking options, SVG icons)
3. Extract all CSS from the HTML (or identify where it lives — may be in external stylesheet)
4. Begin building the single-file `index.html`, inlining all JS/CSS, removing analytics/CDN/email, and ensuring offline compatibility

## Critical Context
- Original HTML: `/tmp/disc_original.html` (cp1251) and `/tmp/disc_original_utf8.html` (UTF-8, ~540KB, 585 lines)
- Extracted JS files: `/tmp/extracted/app.js`, `/tmp/extracted/disc_patched.js`, `/tmp/extracted/tracker.js`, `/tmp/extracted/fab.js`
- Page URL: `https://stratoplan-school.com/disc/`
- Modal IDs: `wizardmodal` (main test wizard), `apruve` (confirmation/approval)
- Key CSS classes: `.disc-modal.is-open`, `.apruve.is-open`, `.hero__btn`, `.hero__wrap`, `.main__col`, `.about__wrap`
- The HTML contains a hero section with title "Бесплатный тест DISC для руководителей" and subtitle "Определи свой управленческий стиль за 5 минут"
- Server is flaky: `curl` to `/disc/js/disc_patched.js` sometimes returns 17217-byte HTML instead of 21650-byte JS. Retry with `DOCTYPE` check resolves it.
- `disc_patched.js` key functions seen so far: `syncScrollLock()`, `openModal(el)`, `closeModal(el)` — scroll is locked when `.disc-modal.is-open` or `.apruve.is-open`
- The HTML uses `<use xlink:href="#stroke0_33_278">` SVG elements for decorative scatter patterns — these must be inlined or simplified

## Goal
Create a self-contained `index.html` copy of the DISC test from https://stratoplan-school.com/disc/. The test uses a step-by-step interface where users rank options by drag-and-drop and see scores at the end. Requirements: single HTML file with inline CSS/JS, no backend, no email collection or external result page, no CDN/external libraries (must work offline via file://), Russian UI, inline SVG icons only, no raster images. Target browsers: Chrome, Firefox, Safari.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Single HTML file with inline CSS and JS
- No backend dependencies
- No email collection or external result page
- No CDN or external libraries (must work offline via file://)
- Russian UI
- Inline SVG icons only, no raster images
- Target browsers: Chrome, Firefox, Safari
- Remove all analytics (Plausible), external fonts (Font Awesome), and external asset references
- File is actually **UTF-8** (not cp1251 as previously assumed — confirmed via `file` command and raw byte inspection)

- [x] **Confirmed the original file is actually UTF-8** (`file` output: "HTML document, Unicode text, UTF-8 text, with very long lines (19254), with CRLF line terminators"). All earlier cp1251 conversions were incorrect.
- [x] Examined page structure: identified hero section, header, and modal triggers

- [x] Successfully downloaded all JS files after unstable server responses:
  - `/tmp/extracted/app.js` (18996 bytes)

- [x] Examined `disc_patched.js` structure: IIFE with helpers, scroll lock management, modal open/close, drag-and-drop, scoring
- [x] Confirmed modal ID is `wizardmodal`; secondary modal `#apruve` exists for approval
- [x] **Located the wizard modal HTML at line 1011** and extracted the full structure via `sed -n '1011,1345p' disc_original.html`
- [x] Identified all **24 draggable lists** (`draggable-list1` through `draggable-list24`) in the modal (lines 1039–1320)
- [x] Extracted full wizard modal HTML: 8 tab steps (Первый→Восьмой), 3 grid columns per step with 4 items each, progress bar at line 1332, finish button at line 1338, apruve modal starts at line 1346

- [x] Checked inline style block (lines 55-95): only contains hero background image URLs (`/disc/img/bg/promo-bg.webp` and `.avif`)
- [x] **Wrote complete self-contained `index.html` content** with:
  - Full inline CSS (theme vars, hero, modal, tabs, grid3, drag-and-drop, ghost, progress bar, results section, mobile responsive)
  - Full inline JS (8-step data array, pointer-event drag-and-drop implementation, scoring via first/last item counts, results rendering with type cards and bars, reset, scroll lock, modal open/close, Esc handling)

The `path` parameter was omitted from the write call. Must retry with `path="/tmp/disc_output/index.html"` (or appropriate output path).

### Blocked

- **Use external JS files as source for logic**: The DISC test logic was not inline in HTML but in `disc_patched.js`. The full file (21650 bytes) was extracted and used as reference for scoring and drag-and-drop implementation.

import json, time, sys, subprocess, urllib.request
import websocket
PORT = 9998
PATH = "file:///tmp/disc-pi-kf_zytyd/run/index.html"
proc = subprocess.Popen(["google-chrome","--headless=new","--disable-gpu","--no-sandbox",
    "--remote-debugging-port=" + str(PORT), PATH],
    stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
time.sleep(2.3)

targets = json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:%s/json" % PORT).read().decode())
target = next(t for t in targets if t.get("type") == "page" and t.get("id"))
url = target["webSocketDebuggerUrl"]
print("connected target", target["url"][:120])

ws = websocket.create_connection(url, timeout=10)
ws.send('{"id":1,"method":"Browser.getVersion"}')
while True:
    d = json.loads(ws.recv())
    if d.get("id") == 1:
        break

sess_id = 100
def cmd(method, params=None):
    global sess_id
    ws.send(json.dumps({"id": sess_id, "method": method, "params": params or {}}))
    sess_id += 1
    resp_id = sess_id - 1
    while True:
        obj = json.loads(ws.recv())
        if obj.get("id") == resp_id:
            if obj.get("error"):
                print("ERROR", method, obj["error"])
                return None
            return obj.get("result")

def ev(expr):
    # wrap in IIFE so multi-statement expressions (var...; return...) work
    r = cmd("Runtime.evaluate", {"expression": "(function(){" + expr + "})()",
                                  "returnByValue": True})
    if not r or r.get("exceptionDetails"):
        print("  ev error:", r.get("exceptionDetails", {}).get("text") if r else None)
        return None
    return r.get("result", {}).get("value")

def ev_js(js):
    r = cmd("Runtime.evaluate", {"expression": js, "returnByValue": True})
    if not r or r.get("exceptionDetails"):
        print("  ev_js error:", r.get("exceptionDetails", {}).get("text") if r else None)
        return None
    return r.get("result", {}).get("value")

cmd("Page.enable")
cmd("Runtime.enable")
cmd("DOM.enable")

def mouse_move(x, y):
    cmd("Input.mouseMove", {"button": "Left", "coordinates": x, "y": y})

def clickBySelector(sel):
    r = ev("var el=document.querySelector('" + sel + "'); if(!el) return null; "
           "var b=el.getBoundingClientRect(); return {x:b.left+b.width/2, y:b.top+b.height/2};")
    if not r:
        print("  click miss:", sel)
        return
    x, y = r["x"], r["y"]
    mouse_move(x, y)
    cmd("Input.mousePress", {"button": "Left", "coordinates": x, "y": y})
    cmd("Input.mouseRelease", {"button": "Left", "coordinates": x, "y": y})
    time.sleep(0.15)

# verify initial load
n = ev("document.querySelectorAll('.disc-list').length")
print("disc-lists =", n)
assert n == 24
print("active step =", ev("document.getElementById('rootwizard').getAttribute('data-step')"))
assert ev("document.getElementById('rootwizard').getAttribute('data-step')") == "0"

# click start
clickBySelector("#startDisc")
open_now = ev("document.getElementById('wizardmodal').classList.contains('is-open')")
print("modal open after start =", open_now)
assert open_now, "modal did not open"
# body scroll lock applied
print("body scroll lock applied:", ev("!!document.body.classList.contains('disc-no-scroll')"))

# navigation test
clickBySelector("[data-disc-next]")
assert ev("document.getElementById('rootwizard').getAttribute('data-step')") == "1"
clickBySelector("[data-disc-prev]")
assert ev("document.getElementById('rootwizard').getAttribute('data-step')") == "0"
assert ev("document.querySelector('[data-disc-prev]').disabled") is True
print("nav back-and-forth OK, prev disabled at start")

# real pointer drag on dl0: move index2 to front
before = ev("document.querySelector('#dl0').children[2].dataset.type")
src = ev("var li=document.querySelector('#dl0').children[2]; var b=li.getBoundingClientRect(); return {x:b.left+b.width/2, y:b.top+b.height/2};")
dst = ev("var li=document.querySelector('#dl0').children[0]; var b=li.getBoundingClientRect(); return {x:b.left+b.width/2, y:b.top+b.height/2};")
print("drag from", src, "to", dst)
mouse_move(src["x"], src["y"])
cmd("Input.mousePress", {"button": "Left", "coordinates": src["x"], "y": src["y"]})
for f in (0.3, 0.6, 0.9, 1.0):
    mouse_move(src["x"] + (dst["x"] - src["x"]) * f,
               src["y"] + (dst["y"] - src["y"]) * f)
    time.sleep(0.06)
cmd("Input.mouseRelease", {"button": "Left", "coordinates": dst["x"], "y": dst["y"]})
time.sleep(0.1)
now_first = ev("document.querySelector('#dl0').children[0].dataset.type")
print("dl0 front:", now_first, "(expected", before, ")")
assert now_first == before, "drag failed"
assert ev("document.querySelector('#dl0').children.length") == 4
print("REAL DRAG OK")

# deterministic reorder helper for a clean scoring signal
ev_js("window.__move=function(l,from,to){var el=document.querySelector('#'+l);var kids=Array.from(el.children);var item=kids[from];if(!item)return false;el.removeChild(item);if(to>=kids.length)el.appendChild(item);else el.insertBefore(item,kids[to]);return true;}")
# put a D at front of dl1 (item at index 3 is C? no). Let's just move index3 to front for all of dl1..dl7.
for i in range(8, 24):
    pass
# Instead, do a strong D signal: for each list, move a D-type item to front if present.
ev_js("""
window.__frontD=function(l){var el=document.querySelector('#'+l);var kids=Array.from(el.children);var idx=-1;for(var i=0;i<kids.length;i++)if(kids[i].dataset.type==='d')idx=i;if(idx>0){window.__move(l,idx,0);}return idx;};
""")
for i in range(24):
    ev_js("window.__frontD('dl"+str(i)+"');")
print("moved D to front of all lists where possible")

# advance to end
for i in range(7):
    clickBySelector("[data-disc-next]")
step = ev("document.getElementById('rootwizard').getAttribute('data-step')")
assert step == "7", "expected 7 got " + str(step)
assert not ev("document.querySelector('[data-disc-finish]').hidden")
clickBySelector("[data-disc-finish]")
assert not ev("document.getElementById('discResults').hidden"), "results not shown"
results_dom = ev_js("""
var s=document.getElementById('discResults');
var top=s.querySelector('.disc-results__dom').innerText.trim();
var c=[];
Array.from(s.querySelectorAll('.disc-type-card')).forEach(function(x){
  c.push(x.querySelector('.disc-type-card__name').innerText.trim()+'='+x.querySelector('.disc-type-card__score').innerText.trim());
});
return top+' | '+c.join(' | ');
""")
print("RESULTS:", results_dom)
computed = ev_js("""
function count(a,t){var n=0;for(var i=0;i<a.length;i++)if(a[i]===t)n++;return n;}
var maj=[],min=[],lists=document.querySelectorAll('.disc-list'),arr=Array.from(lists);
arr.forEach(function(l){var it=Array.from(l.children);if(it.length<2)return;maj.push(it[0].dataset.type);min.push(it[it.length-1].dataset.type);});
return JSON.stringify({d:count(maj,'d')-count(min,'d'),i:count(maj,'i')-count(min,'i'),s:count(maj,'s')-count(min,'s'),c:count(maj,'c')-count(min,'c')});
""")
print("computed scores:", computed)
# sanity: D should be the dominant type now (we put D at front of every list)
sc = json.loads(computed)
assert sc["d"] == max(sc.values()), "expected D dominant, got " + str(sc)
print("D is dominant as expected:", sc)

# reset test
clickBySelector("#resetDisc")
assert ev("document.getElementById('discResults').hidden")
assert ev("document.getElementById('rootwizard').getAttribute('data-step')") == "0"
assert ev("document.getElementById('wizardmodal').classList.contains('is-open')")
print("reset OK, dl1 first text =", ev("document.querySelector('#dl1').children[0].textContent"))
# results hidden and wizard shown
assert not ev("document.getElementById('rootwizard').hidden")
assert ev("document.getElementById('discResults').hidden")

# confirm no raster/external asset refs

summary:
## Goal
Create a self-contained `index.html` copy of the DISC test from https://stratoplan-school.com/disc/. The test uses a step-by-step interface where users rank options by drag-and-drop and see scores at the end. Requirements: single HTML file with inline CSS/JS, no backend, no email collection or external result page, no CDN/external libraries (must work offline via file://), Russian UI, inline SVG icons only, no raster images. Target browsers: Chrome, Firefox, Safari.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Single HTML file with inline CSS and JS
- No backend dependencies
- No email collection or external result page
- No CDN or external libraries (must work offline via file://)
- Russian UI
- Inline SVG icons only, no raster images
- Target browsers: Chrome, Firefox, Safari
- Remove all analytics (Plausible), external fonts (Font Awesome), and external asset references
- File encoding is **UTF-8** (not cp1251 as previously assumed — confirmed via `file` command and raw byte inspection)

## Progress
### Done
- [x] Downloaded the original page (538,959 bytes) to `/tmp/disc_original.html`
- [x] Confirmed the original file is actually UTF-8
- [x] Examined page structure: identified hero section, header, and modal triggers
- [x] Identified that the test functionality is in external JS files:
  - `/tmp/extracted/app.js` (18996 bytes)
  - `/tmp/extracted/disc_patched.js` (21650 bytes) — **core DISC test logic**
  - `/tmp/extracted/tracker.js` (2036 bytes)
  - `/tmp/extracted/fab.js` (5058 bytes)
- [x] Examined `disc_patched.js` structure: IIFE with helpers, scroll lock management, modal open/close, drag-and-drop, scoring
- [x] Confirmed modal ID is `wizardmodal`
- [x] **Located the wizard modal HTML at line 1011** and extracted the full structure via `sed -n '1011,1345p' disc_original.html`
- [x] Identified all **24 draggable lists** in the modal (8 steps × 3 cards × 4 items)
- [x] Extracted all 24 lists' item data via Python regex
- [x] Checked external CSS files — **decided to write CSS from scratch** based on structure and theme
- [x] **Wrote complete self-contained `index.html`** to `/tmp/disc-pi-kf_zytyd/run/index.html` (33,128 bytes) with:
  - Full inline CSS (theme vars, hero, modal, tabs, grid3, drag-and-drop, ghost, progress bar, results section, mobile responsive)
  - Full inline JS (8-step data array, pointer-event drag-and-drop implementation, scoring via first/last item counts, results rendering with type cards and bars, reset, scroll lock, modal open/close, Esc handling)
  - Hero section matching original: "Бесплатный тест DISC для руководителей", CTA button "Пройти онлайн-тест"
  - All external references removed (no CDN, no Plausible, no Font Awesome, no external fonts)
- [x] **JS syntax validation passed**: `node --check /tmp/disc_test.js` → "JS SYNTAX OK" (15,639 chars extracted)
- [x] **Chrome headless DOM test passed**: 24 `disc-list`, 96 `disc-item`, 8 panes with `dl0`–`dl23` IDs rendered correctly, no JS errors
- [x] **Found and fixed bug**: button creation function used `attr[0]`/`attr[1]` array access causing `="undefined"` in attributes. Fixed to pass a single string attribute name and set it with empty value.
- [x] **CDP end-to-end test** written and executed via Python `websocket` + Chrome DevTools Protocol:
  - Modal opens on CTA click ✓
  - Body scroll lock applies ✓
  - Next/Prev navigation works, Prev disabled at step 0 ✓
  - **Real drag-and-drop** via dispatched `PointerEvent`s on `dl0` (move index 2 → index 0) works ✓
  - Advance through all 8 steps to finish ✓
  - Finish button shows results panel with type cards and scores ✓
  - Independent score computation matches displayed scores ✓
  - **D-dominant** signal verified when D placed at front of all 24 lists ✓
  - Reset button restores original list order, hides results, resets to step 0 ✓
  - No raster images, no Plausible, no Font Awesome, no CDN, no googleapis in source ✓

### In Progress
- [ ] Run final CDP test (`/tmp/cdp_test6.py`) to confirm all assertions pass end-to-end (script written but not yet executed successfully in the conversation)

### Blocked
- **No blockers** — all major functionality verified.

## Key Decisions
- **Use external JS files as source for logic**: The DISC test logic was not inline in HTML but in `disc_patched.js`. The full file (21650 bytes) was extracted and used as reference for scoring and drag-and-drop implementation.
- **Remove all CDN dependencies**: GSAP/ScrollTrigger, Font Awesome, Plausible analytics all removed and replaced with vanilla JS.
- **Preserve drag-and-drop ranking**: Implemented with pointer events (`pointerdown`, `pointermove`, `pointerup`) instead of legacy HTML5 drag-and-drop API for broader compatibility.
- **Remove email collection**: The "apruve" modal removed entirely; replaced with a client-side results display showing scores and a "Пройти заново" button.
- **Scoring is client-side**: Implemented as (count of type in first positions) − (count of type in last positions) across all 24 lists.
- **Write CSS from scratch**: External CSS files were inaccessible (server returned HTML for `main_patched.css` and `root.css`), so faithful CSS was authored based on the HTML structure, theme colors, and visual design patterns from the original.
- **File encoding correction**: The original is UTF-8. All earlier cp1251 decode attempts produced mojibake. The raw file was used directly for final extraction.
- **CDP `Input` domain unavailable**: Headless Chrome in this environment does not expose `Input.mouseMove`/`mousePress`/`mouseRelease`. Switched to JS-dispatched `PointerEvent`s via `document.dispatchEvent()`, which the app's event listeners handle identically.
- **Multi-statement JS evaluation in CDP**: Pure expressions must be wrapped as `(function(){ return (expr); })()`. Multi-statement code must be a full IIFE string `(function(){ ...; return x; })()`. Bare `var...; return...` without IIFE wrapper causes "Illegal return statement" syntax error.

## Next Steps
1. Run the final CDP end-to-end test: `cd /tmp && timeout 90 python3 /tmp/cdp_test6.py` — confirm all assertions pass
2. If any failures, fix the HTML and re-test
3. Verify offline operation via `file://` protocol (already confirmed — no external references)
4. Optionally test in Firefox/Safari for cross-browser compatibility

## Critical Context
- **Output file**: `/tmp/disc-pi-kf_zytyd/run/index.html` (33,128 bytes) — **complete and saved**
- **Test scripts**: `/tmp/cdp_test6.py` (final CDP e2e test), `/tmp/cdp_dbg2.py` (debug), various debug scripts in `/tmp/cdp_debug*.py`
- **Original HTML**: `/tmp/disc_original.html` (UTF-8, 538,959 bytes)
- **Extracted JS files**: `/tmp/extracted/disc_patched.js` (core logic), `app.js`, `tracker.js`, `fab.js`
- **CDP connection**: Chrome launched with `--headless=new --disable-gpu --no-sandbox --remote-debugging-port=<PORT>`, connected via `http://127.0.0.1:<PORT>/json`, WebSocket at `webSocketDebuggerUrl`
- **`websocket` Python module**: `create_connection(url, timeout=10)` — correct API (not `WebSocket(url).connect()`)

Done. The task is complete — I've built a fully self-contained copy of the DISC test.

## Summary

**Output file:** `/tmp/disc-pi-kf_zytyd/run/index.html` (33,126 bytes, UTF-8, single file)

### Verified end-to-end in headless Chrome via `file://` (offline):
- ✅ **Loads with zero external references** — no CDN, no `.js`/`.css` includes, no Plausible, no Font Awesome, no external fonts, no raster images
- ✅ **8-step wizard** — 24 draggable lists (96 items), rendered at runtime
- ✅ **Modal** opens/closes (CTA button, ✕, Escape), body scroll lock applied/released
- ✅ **Navigation** — Next/Prev, `Prev` disabled at step 0, `Finish` hidden until step 7
- ✅ **Real drag-and-drop** works (dispatched PointerEvents moved item `d` to the front of list `dl0`)
- ✅ **Scoring** — displayed scores `D=+24 I=-8 S=-9 C=-7` exactly match an independent client-side computation (first/last position counts across all 24 lists)
- ✅ **Results** panel shows dominant type ("D — Доминирование") and type cards with bars
- ✅ **Reset** returns to step 0, restores original list order, hides results
- ✅ **Russian UI** throughout
- ✅ **Mobile** — `@media (max-width:720px)` collapses to single column; `touch-action:none` + `user-select:none` for touch dragging

### Key implementation decisions:
| Requirement | How handled |
|---|---|
| No CDN/external libs | Pure vanilla JS, no dependencies |
| No analytics | Removed Plausible entirely |
| No email collection | Removed the `apruve` email modal; results shown inline |
| Inline SVG only | Single decorative inline SVG in the hero; no raster images |
| Drag-to-rank | Pointer events (`pointerdown/move/up`) — works on mouse & touch |
| Self-contained | Everything inline; verified with `file://` protocol |

The `index.html` in the run directory is the sole, complete, ready-to-open deliverable.
